<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/download_node_file"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Serves one of a node's files as a download.

Separate from get_node_files, which hands the directory to the editor
(a binary file listed without its bytes): this writes a file to the user's own machine, so it is
gated on SCRIPTS_EDIT in AUTHpermissionMap rather than being an open read
like the rest of the scripting page's fetches.

The bytes go out as-is rather than through read_text: a file the editor
can't render (an attachment sitting next to the script, say) is still a
file the author may want a copy of, and re-encoding one would corrupt it.
